original_content_full:
Contributions to the DGPF Annual Meeting

Jan Klimke is presenting a paper entitled "Datenintegration in dienstbasierte 3D-Geovisualisierungssysteme für mobile Geräte" at the DGPF annual meeting.

Link to the publication.

Also, Benjamin Hagedorn gave a Tutorial about "Web-based Visualization of Massive 3D City Models" on March 14 as part of the pre-conference program. 

The DGPF annual meeting is currently held at the Hasso-Plattner-Institut and is also co-organized by our group.

Link to the conference.
